error.description: Optional failure details. Known Source failures use HTTP 422 and fixed safe stage/message/repair; path/reason are emitted only for known matching validation categories. No upstream body, credential, SQL or automatic retry guarantee is included.

allowControl.description: Optional; omission preserves the saved value. New and legacy installations default to false. Does not cancel admitted actions or block result queries.

operation.description: Exact native resource operation name from the shared UNS contract; Fleet does not keep a separate business-resource allowlist.

payload.description: Operation-specific body; business data is delivered through Collection storage.

username.description: Login account captured when this session was created; later profile edits do not change it.

errorCode.description: Stable SSH connection failure code, persisted with the terminal session; empty if no connection failure.

setupError.description: Stable SSH failure code; includes SSH_PORT_BLOCKED, SSH_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE, SSH_TIMEOUT, SSH_PORT_REFUSED, SSH_AUTH_REJECTED, SSH_HOST_KEY_CHANGED, SSH_CREDENTIAL_INVALID, SSH_HANDSHAKE_FAILED, SSH_PROXY_UNAVAILABLE, SSH_ACCESS_UNAVAILABLE and SSH_CA_PENDING. No credentials or raw transport errors.

allowControl.description: Edge-owned remote Control admission switch; defaults to false. Per-Control published capability and grants remain required.

businessStatus.description: Result of a fresh authenticated center probe, independent of persisted registration.

tokenConfigured.description: The local Agent retains a configured token. The secret is never returned.

connectionReason.description: The requested token target does not match the existing business registration. Do not show the previous center as connected to the new target.

connected.description: A pinned center connection is configured; this does not assert current network availability.

defaultPending.description: First-connection local-and-center default awaits definition synchronization and validation.

deliveryCenterId.description: Identity of the currently saved center binding; empty when none is valid. Delivery counters refer only to this center, not a pending registration candidate.

pending.description: Retained undelivered events for other or no-longer-bound centers, including unknown legacy destinations.

failed.description: Historical pending events whose last attempt failed.

centers.description: Distinct historical destinations with pending events; an unknown destination counts as one.

received.description: Accepted events for the saved center binding only, including retained completed events.

pending.description: Durable events not yet acknowledged as committed by the center.

committed.description: Events acknowledged after the center transaction committed.

failed.description: Pending events whose last attempt failed; retained and retried.

FleetBootstrap.description: Existing collaboration credential; never a user session.

FleetTask.description: Short-lived node/task identity, bound to target, exact operation and resource. Enrollment/exchange instead verify the signed request proof.

Tier0Session.description: Tier0 session with operation-specific platform permission; not an external API key.
